rule: a volume blocks a walker standing at floor height f when y0 < f + 1.8 and y1 > f + 0.35, unless stand and y1 - f <= 0.35 (a step); a shot at height h is stopped when y0 <= h <= y1; stand = the top is a drawn flat surface; a piece's `thin` boxes are open frames (rings, hoops, rails, wire, lattice, fronds) left out of the volumes: they stop neither a walker nor a shot
